notes.title: Update 1.1.0
notes.notes:
Update 1.1.0 is now available!
In this update, we have added new items and weapons. And also fixed a number of detected bugs and made minor changes to the balance.
Have a nice game!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39250027/da3abdadbf5ed8f2b1510146253c86e5c8f3a6b5.jpg

notes.title: Update 1.0.4
notes.notes:
Hi!

We have just released update 1.0.4.
This is a small update aimed at fixing bugs and improving balance.
In addition, brightness adjustment has been added to the options menu.

notes.title: Game Release!
Release date and price increase information.
notes.notes:
Hi!

Some news about the release date of One More Dungeon 2.
The game will leave Early Access on September 19th.
We also plan to raise the price of the game a week after leaving early access.
In the meantime, you can check out the new trailer :)

notes.title: Update 0.3
notes.notes:
Changelog:

 The third area of the dungeon, with a new environment, traps, enemies and a Boss.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39250027/2c09d2717e70e4dd1719a11ffc73d5dd3d7a2d8f.jpg
 Improved behavior of some enemies.
 Added a class system. At the moment, there are three basic classes available - Stranger, Wizard and Warrior, each with its own unique skill.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39250027/c7ebfaa4bbfed14f0647efc145785c851d06bf67.jpg
 Expanded hub location. Added a Merchant Tent that allows you to buy items before going into the dungeon.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39250027/5200f051f94d41243fbadead0b48f0cf07d589da.png
 Added flooded areas on levels.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39250027/123c4ee2eb1ac164c382767373b0c6db29a15cd1.jpg
 New negative effect - Burning.
 Dark Idols are objects that appear on levels and apply a negative effect until they are destroyed.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39250027/399fcd62712b89c5db9e96fa10a719c500a1471e.jpg
 Lots of minor fixes and improvements.
